description: List the kinds of connector Foundry offers a workspace, and whether its plan includes each: a Foundry Pro kind is unavailable without Pro. helix_foundry_connect connects one, a kind with sign_in by signing in at its provider and any other through its form; an API source (events) has no credential, so create one with the create_event_source operation.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_list_connector_kinds
title: List connector kinds
